properties.name: fork_point and reopen_choice: a settled decision can be returned to, and re-opened without being un-accepted
properties.rationale: Finishes step 4 on Anthony's rulings of 2026-09-23. Measured before building: only 37 of 454 accepted decisions were pinned to an epoch, so the fork-point coordinate had no address for 92% of them without the git fallback.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: New core module fork.rs (fork_point, reopen_decision), git.rs earliest_export_containing (bisected), read tool fork_point and write tool reopen_choice. cap:fork-alternatives planned → realized. The revise-design skill routes a change of mind about a settled decision through them. find_tools corpus gains two user-phrased queries; two long-standing confusable pairs came apart and were removed from the rank baseline; vocabulary_reach places reopen_choice as a Decision writer; skill_lint allowlists road_taken_location.
